Messages.Author: captnchuck
Messages.Body: Can a Camarilla Vampire use cards marked with a Sabbat logo.I am not meaning the obvious ones but interrupts minoins,allies and such.

Messages.Author: Klaital
Messages.Body: Yes if it doesn't actually say something along the lines of 'requires a sabbat vampire' in the text box of the card. Set symbols have no effect in game play.

Messages.Author: salem
Messages.Body:
It actually depends on what you mean by 'sabbat symbol'.

If you're talking about cards that require a clan, and you're asking about the camarilla clan symbols with the red blood splot behind them, then no, camarilla clans cannot play their equivalent sabbat clan cards. Brujah is a completely seperate clan to Brujah antitibu as far as all the rules are concerned (etc with the other clans).
